violation_type.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))
violation_type.short_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit
violation_type.typical_finding: One of four  of the transportation vehicles did not have a first aid kit available for review.  The other 3 vehicles were missing or had expired supplies from the first aid kits that were added during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: One of four  of the transportation vehicles did not have a first aid kit available for review.  The other 3 vehicles were missing or had expired supplies from the first aid kits that were added during the inspection.
One of the two transportation vehicles did not contain a First Aid Kit as required.   NOTE:  This was corrected at inspection when the director placed an extra First Aid Kit into the vehicle.
At the time of the inspection the vehicle used for transportation did not have a first aid kit present.

During the inspection it was found that one of the transportation vehicles was missing it's first aid kit, and some of the other first aid kits in the other vehicles were missing items. This was corrected at inspection when all of the first aid kits were made complete and one was added to the vehicle that did not have one.
First aid kit reviewed in the transportation vehicle was missing tape, guide to first aid, thermometer, gloves, scissors.
The first aid kit in the van did not have a pair of scissors. This was corrected at inspection.
